title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its result

translated_title: MH-RAG-DIVE：通过树缓存对话模拟实现动态且高性价比的多跳RAG评估
translated_abstract: 质量评估对于判断对检索增强生成系统的改动是否能提升或保持其性能至关重要。然而，现有的评估方法通常依赖单轮或单跳交互，因此无法捕捉多跳、多轮对话的复杂性。我们提出了MH-RAG-DIVE，这是一个动态交互式用户模拟框架，旨在更复杂的多跳和多轮场景中评估RAG系统。该框架通过一个上下文发现器扩展了RAG-DIVE，该发现器能够在进行中的对话中识别可以组合生成多跳问题的文档。为了解决动态用户模拟的高计算成本问题，我们进一步引入了一个对话缓存器，它会复用之前评估运行中的对话轮次，同时保持评估的动态特性。我们在六种不同的RAG配置上对该框架进行了评估，并将其结果与其他方法进行比较。
tldr: 提出MH-RAG-DIVE框架，通过上下文发现器和对话缓存器，在保持评估动态性的同时大幅降低计算成本，实现了多跳多轮场景下的动态RAG系统评估。
en_tdlr: MH-RAG-DIVE enables dynamic, cost-efficient evaluation of multi-hop, multi-turn RAG systems by combining a Context Discoverer for generating multi-hop questions with a Conversation Cacher that reuses dialogue turns.
